This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is filed by the claimant being aggrieved of the award dated 19.01.2023 passed by the learned Third Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Katni (M.P.) in MACC No.279/2020 ( Sandeep Tamrakar Vs. Suresh Kumar Kushwaha and others), on the ground that claimant Sandeep Tamrakar suffered grievous injuries in an accident which took place on 24.03.2020, whereas Tribunal has been awarded a sum of Rs.45,899/- under various heads, which is too meager and inadequate 2.

sentences.text: It is submitted by Shri Sharad Gupta, learned counsel for the appellant that claimant Sandeep Tamrakar suffered fracture of right hand besides other injuries.
It is submitted that meager amounts have been awarded under different heads and they need to be enhanced.
Therefore, it is submitted that adequate compensation should have been awarded.

3. Shri Diwakar Nath Shukla, learned counsel for the respondent-insurance NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6391 2 MA-2339-2023 company supports the impugned award and submits that no interference is called for in the same.
4. After hearing learned counsel for the appellant and going through the record, looking to the nature of fracture and injuries, a sum of Rs.25,000/- is awarded under the head of fracture.

sentences.text: 1 Tribunal has awarded only a sum of Rs.7,000/- under the head of loss of earning, which is enhanced to Rs.16,000/- at the rate of Rs.8,000/- per month for a period of two months.
Thus, there will be enhancement to the tune of Rs.9,000/- under the head of loss of earning.
Tribunal has not awarded any amount under the head of Attendant, under which head a sum of Rs.8,000/- is awarded at the rate of Rs.4,000/- per month for a period of 2 months.
Tribunal has awarded only a sum of Rs.2,000/- under the head of Nutritious Diet, which is enhanced to Rs.6,000/-.
Thus, there will be enhancement of Rs.4,000/- under the head of Nutritious Diet.

Tribunal has not awarded any amount under the head of Future Treatment, under which head a sum of Rs.5,000/- is awarded,
taking total compensation to Rs.96,899/- in place of Rs.45,899/- awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal.
5. Thus, there will be enhancement to the tune of Rs.51,000/- (Rupees Fifty One thousand only) for which claimant will be entitled to in addition to the amount awarded by learned Claims Tribunal.

This additional amount will also earn interest at the rate of 6% per annum, as has been awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal, from the date of filing of claim petition till the date of actual payment.
Other terms and conditions of the award shall remain intact.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6391 3 MA-2339-2023 6.
In above terms, this miscellaneous appeal is disposed of.
7. Record of the Claims Tribunal be sent back.
